note: A replacement for the phase-1 floorplan metric that broke. 'Plateau width at dt_max' degenerates to the whole die once dt_max reaches the die's own temperature span, which the DEMONSTRATED 45 K does -- see tier_screens_dt_ladder.json. This is the device-independent metric that replaces it, validated against the same eleven workload shapes. No new solves: computed from the block temperatures the tier screens already recorded.
design_rule: A floorplan metric must not depend on a device parameter that can move under it. The old metric was informative only because dt_max was pinned at an unsourced 10 K; when the envelope was corrected to its demonstrated value the metric silently stopped measuring anything.
definition: relative_plateau(temps, fraction=0.25): blocks within `fraction` of the die's OWN peak-to-minimum temperature span of the peak. Self-normalising, no device parameter.

validation.against_the_legacy_metric: Spearman 0.934 against plateau-at-dt_max=10 K across eleven shapes: it preserves the ordering the old metric produced, with only two adjacent swaps.
validation.discrimination: 12.3x across shapes, against 18.7x for the legacy metric at 10 K and 1.0x -- no information -- for the legacy metric at the demonstrated 45 K.
validation.chosen_fraction: 0.25, where agreement with the legacy ordering peaks. Correlation stays 0.76-0.93 over 0.10-0.50, so the choice is not delicate.
validation.cross_check: Correlates -0.834 with the peak-to-runner-up gap -- the right sign, since a large gap means a narrow plateau -- confirming both describe the same structure while the plateau sees past the top two blocks.

gen_0_status_of_the_five_phase_1_metrics.peak_to_runner_up_gap: BUILT and validated; device-independent; 6.8x across shapes
gen_0_status_of_the_five_phase_1_metrics.plateau_width: REPLACED by relative_plateau; the dt_max form is retired as degenerate
gen_0_status_of_the_five_phase_1_metrics.power_density_concentration: NOW BUILT -- power_density_concentration(), area-weighted Gini plus top-decile share, from a trace and a floorplan, no solve
gen_0_status_of_the_five_phase_1_metrics.thermal_aspect: NOW BUILT -- thermal_aspect() / hot_block_thermal_aspect(), geometry only
gen_0_status_of_the_five_phase_1_metrics.tile_alignment_at_a_pitch: mr_array.coverage_report exists; relationship to benefit still untested

what_is_still_owed: The deliverable in LADDER_GEN0 section 3 is a REGRESSION of measured MR benefit against these metrics, across floorplan and workload variants, with any metric that does not predict dropped. The metrics now exist and are tested; the regression has not been run.
